description: Read the app's storage keys across ALL backends: AsyncStorage, MMKV (per instance), and Expo SecureStore. Data wrong or missing after an app restart → read the persisted values here FIRST — the bug is usually a stale, missing, or malformed stored value, and reading it beats hunting for it in code. Compact by DEFAULT — keys only — so it's token-cheap; pass includeValues:true for the values (truncated), or a `pattern` substring to narrow. Buoy's own internal keys are already filtered out.

deviceId.description: The device to act on: its id from list_devices or from your instructions. Pass it whenever more than one app may be connected. Once a call names a device, later calls in this session use it when deviceId is left out.

includeValues.description: Include each key's value (truncated). Default false (keys only).

limit.description: Max keys per backend section. Default 100.

name: get_storage
